messages:
Rafael: quick PSA: multi-model routing rollout exposed that model_label was removed and collapsed into model.meta.name. billing joins downstream expect model_label.
June: saw the spike. surprised tests didn't catch it. where did the gap happen?
Rafael: producer tests validate local schema but consumers (billing, observability) aren't pinned to contracts. change slipped through.
Priyanka: can we add a small gating check in the router CI that runs consumer contract tests for the billing and obs jobs? just run their small critical queries.
June: yes. propose lightweight smoke tests: run the billing join query against the producer test payload and assert non-null model_label. fail merge if it fails.
Rafael: also add a post-merge hook that creates a temp alias mapping: model_label -> model.meta.name for 30 days. opt-in per-service. keeps dashboards stable while consumers migrate.
Priyanka: we should record alias usage metrics and auto-notify owners if alias hit count drops slowly (meaning consumers migrated).
ops-bot: note: added CI webhook templated test for router service 2026-03-29T12:45:00Z :white_check_mark:
June: small doc ask: update PR template to require listing affected consumers and whether a contract entry exists. that will help reviewers.
Rafael: action items: Rafael to add smoke-test harness (due Tue), Priyanka to add alias telemetry + registry entry (due Thu), June to update PR template (done today).
Priyanka: bonus: add a nightly lint job that scans recent merges for telemetry key changes and emails affected consumer owners. low-cost detection.
Rafael: agreed. this should cut down "silent break" incidents. thanks.
